build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: on-wire request capture, complete, below the encoder (an incomplete capture yields unknown, which HOLDS the leg)
the executor's captured invocation identity for each tool call
a governed read of gov-rel-1 resolving at the protocol grain

legs: byte-exact JCS preimage parity: m-9's executor derivation and the m-3 observer's derivation hash IDENTICAL bytes for one logical presented env set
duplicate-name reject: a construction-time duplicate env name is rejected, never last-wins
reachable non-UTF-8 reject: a generated non-UTF-8 env value is a pre-spawn typed reject, never a silent skip
RED leg: a digest taken over the PRE-SANITIZATION parent environment must FAIL the parity check

r7_mirror.check_performed: yes, at E3-predicate authoring, as the brief requires
r7_mirror.contingency: this holds because the leg is authored on the completed-send class above; a refusal-cut gov-1 would HOLD on unknown rather than pass, so a 2a/2b-dependent gov-1 is not constructible
r7_mirror.disposition: non-gating deferred, recorded explicitly; NOT a route-now escalation
r7_mirror.grounds: the three GATING predicates are provider_request_matches_frozen_core, local_invocation_matches_effect_descriptor and relay_record_committed_with_stamped_sender; none takes the m-3 B-sink record, presence_class or m10_row_state as an input. Predicate 1 keys on the provider REQUEST m-8 sent, never on the m-8->m-9 DATA-P reply, and the 2a/2b split is a property of that reply. The two predicates nearest the refusal surface are non-gating by the ratified D2 fold. Independence therefore remains COVERAGE, not correctness — the exact condition under which the v3 deferral stands.
r7_mirror.result: NO independent m-10-side 2a/2b resolution is needed by this leg

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

drive.why: exercises the only action carrying env_digest + shell_interpreter_ref, the inputs predicate 3 compares
the freeze->authorize->attach->send path that produces frozen_core_digest
produces the channel-stamped committed relay record predicate 4 resolves
exercises the ordered target-set digest form of canonical_resource

fault.applies_to: the negative control run only; the positive run executes the identical drive with no injection
fault.cut_definition: A TEST-ONLY single-byte mutation of a non-secret frozen-core-covered header value applied to the outgoing bytes AFTER m-8's step-5 recompute-and-compare guard has passed, so the mutation reaches the wire without tripping the producer's own integrity check. This is the only point at which the emitted request can legally diverge from the authorized frozen core; it exists to prove predicate 1 discriminates.

negative_controls: mutated wire (the fault above) => predicate 1 verdict=fail
a descriptor field mismatched against the captured invocation => predicate 3 verdict=fail
an unobtainable shell_interpreter_ref.content_id => predicate 3 verdict=unknown and the leg HOLDS, never a weaker pass
a relay record whose stamped FROM differs from the expected sender => predicate 4 verdict=fail
an authoritative not_found on the relay id => predicate 4 verdict=fail (a completed validated denial is evidence of absence)
an unavailable governed read => predicate 4 verdict=unknown, leg HOLDS
objective: Prove all three GATING E3 predicates reach verdict=pass on one honest governed turn, and prove each can reach fail under a single injected divergence so no pass is vacuous.

run_setup.capture: the observer independently captures the on-wire request below the encoder and derives frozen_core_digest per the m-8 recipe; it never byte-copies the carried value (the F84 rail)
run_setup.provider_class: m-8 BE-addendum row 5 — sent, terminal `completed`: freeze completed (P1 PRESENT), complete request written (P2a=1), so predicate 1 is ELIGIBLE and DECIDABLE. This class is REQUIRED: on any refusal/loss class predicate 1 lands on an unknown branch and HOLDS the leg rather than passing.
